name: Vote
definition: Number of votes assigned to each voting option.

For.name: For
For.definition: Number of votes in favour of one resolution

Against.name: Against
Against.definition: Number of votes against one resolution

Abstain.name: Abstain
Abstain.definition: Number of votes declared abstained for one resolution.

Withhold.name: Withhold
Withhold.definition: Number of votes withheld for one resolution

WithManagement.name: With Management
WithManagement.definition: Number of votes in line with the votes of the management.

AgainstManagement.name: Against Management
AgainstManagement.definition: Number of votes against the voting recommendation of the management.

NoAction.name: No Action
NoAction.definition: Number of votes for which no action has been taken.

TwoYears.name: Two Years
TwoYears.definition: Number of votes in favour of two years for "say on pay" type of resolution.

OneYear.name: One Year
OneYear.definition: Number of votes in favour for one year for "say on pay" type of resolution.

ThreeYears.name: Three Years
ThreeYears.definition: Number of votes in favour of three years for "say on pay" type of resolution.

Blank.name: Blank
Blank.definition: Vote is cast as empty but the vote is counted.

VoteReceiptDateTime.name: Vote Receipt Date Time
VoteReceiptDateTime.definition: Date or date and time at which the votes that have been recorded and counted were received.

VoteRequest.name: Vote Request
VoteRequest.definition: Request which contains the vote instructions.

Resolution.name: Resolution
Resolution.definition: Specifies the agenda item on which a vote is/was cast.

Result.name: Result
Result.definition: Information on the vote result for a specific resolution.
